goal: Populate BIP 174 global xpubs in PSBTs created from multi-key descriptors
Enable stateless hardware signers like BitBox02 to verify and sign multisig configurations
reviewability: Review is paused waiting on the author to respond to architectural objections from achow101
agreement: Unaddressed blocking objection: restricts global xpubs to multisig rather than handling generically (achow101)
Unaddressed blocking objection: MuSig descriptor parsing omits participant extended public keys (achow101)
Unaddressed objection: interface uses unnecessary output parameters and signing provider requirements (achow101)
Unaddressed objection: makes caller assumptions instead of returning root keys when cache misses (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because hardware signers like BitBox02 refuse to sign multisig PSBTs lacking global xpubs
Resolves an interoperability failure preventing users from completing multisig signer workflows
